svg.title: One decode token, from the host to the hardware and back
svg.desc: Three bands, host, firmware on the RISC-V control core and hardware, with seven numbered steps. 1: llama.cpp builds the ggml graph and ggml-tesseract turns it into a cached op list; the weights already sit in card DDR. 2: the transport writes the token inputs to DDR and pushes one launch descriptor over PCIe. 3: the runtime takes the launch and the Basis graph kernel walks the op list. 4: the kernel issues tile ops through the issue path and unit queues. 5: the DMA moves activations and KV rows between DDR and the 4 MiB SPM, each of four MVM clusters streams weights from its own DDR4 channel, the vector unit and attention ops work in the SPM, and the KV cache stays in DDR. 6: results go back to DDR and the runtime posts an answer record. 7: the host reads the answer and the logits.
